talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $141.4M sold across 5 Form D filings this week, up 262% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Brookwood Golf Group of Michigan LLC (Hudsonville, Other Real Estate) targeting $3M. Good question to ask: are founders in real estate favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

3 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $138.1M raised so far — led by Northern Shore Capital Fund I-A LP (Private Equity Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
Private Funds was the most active sector with 3 of 6 filings (50%). Ask contacts what's driving the activity, and whether it's showing up in their pipeline.
